to: clients and observers near the target, and the attacker in all cases. A miss, an evade or an avoid goes to clients near the start point of the `action`. A burn tick goes only to clients near the burned entity

payload.type: HitDamage | HitMiss | HitEvade | HitAvoid | HitReflect | HitBurn

confirm.note: Every emit of `hit`; the `events.push(["hit", def])` path is off while `mode.instant_monster_attacks` is 1 (node/server.js:292)

variants.name: Damage or heal
variants.when: The projectile reached the target. One event for each target that it hit (splash, a stack of characters on one spot).

confirm.note: One `def` per attack, changed for each target; `crit`, `aoe`, `purify`, `sneak`, `trigger`, `deepfreeze`, `lifesteal`, `manasteal`, `goldsteal`, `mobbing`, `stacked` are not reset between targets

variants.name: Miss
variants.when: The attack missed: the target disconnected or died, the `miss` of the attacker rolled, or the `avoidance` of the target rolled. Also a splash target whose `avoidance` rolled.

variants.name: Evade
variants.when: The target evaded: its `evasion` rolled. Only for physical damage (`armor` defense).

confirm.note: `defense` is armor only for physical (or no) damage type

variants.name: Avoid
variants.when: The target moved more than 72 px (108 px for a heal) from the start point, or changed maps.

variants.name: Reflect
variants.when: The target reflected a magical projectile. A new `action` follows at once, from the target to the attacker.

variants.name: Burn tick
variants.when: The `burned` condition did damage. It has no `pid`, because no projectile caused it.

confirm.note: `burned` is only added at node/server.js:4073, always with `f` and `fid`, so `hid` is always present

HitDamage.summary: A `hit` from a projectile that reached its target: the damage or the heal, and the effects that happened.
HitDamage.description: The server builds one `def` object for the attack (node/server.js:3229) and changes it for each target. Flags that are not in the list at node/server.js:3964-3973 can stay from an earlier target of the same attack.

fields.name: hid
fields.description: The id of the attacker.

fields.name: source
fields.description: The skill, for example `"attack"`, `"heal"`, `"supershot"`.

fields.name: projectile
fields.description: A key of `G.projectiles`. The server starts it as `null` (node/server.js:3229-3249), but `commence_attack` then reads `G.projectiles[def.projectile].speed` (node/server.js:3582-3583), which throws for `null`, so every `hit` that is sent has a string.

fields.name: damage_type
fields.description: The damage type at the start of the attack: `"physical"`, `"magical"` or `"pure"` (node/server.js:3539). Absent when the attacker has none.

fields.name: pid
fields.description: The projectile id of the first `action`. A reflected projectile keeps this id; see Notes.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The id of the target of this event.

fields.name: damage
fields.description: The HP that the target lost, after shields. Absent for a heal.

fields.name: heal
fields.description: Only for a heal: the HP that the target got (node/server.js:3999).

fields.name: kill
fields.description: The HP of the target is 0 or less.

fields.name: crit
fields.description: A critical hit: the damage multiplier, `2 + critdamage / 100` (node/server.js:4016-4017).

fields.name: lifesteal
fields.description: The HP that the attacker got back (node/server.js:4183).

fields.name: manasteal
fields.description: The MP that the attacker took from the target (node/server.js:4199).

fields.name: goldsteal
fields.description: A monster with `goldsteal` took this gold, 1 to 12 (node/server.js:4204-4207). The heal path sets `-88`; no monster in G heals with `goldsteal`.

fields.name: mp_damage
fields.description: `mshield`: the MP that the shield used instead of HP (node/server.js:4227-4231).

fields.name: shield_reaction
fields.description: The shield condition of the target that reacted (node/server.js:4236, 4282).

fields.name: mp_restored
fields.description: `aether_shield`: the MP that the paladin target got back from magical damage. Can be `0` (node/server.js:4281).

fields.name: redirected
fields.description: `guardians_oath`: the damage that went to the guardian instead (node/server.js:4246).

fields.name: guardian
fields.description: `guardians_oath`: the paladin that took `redirected` (node/server.js:4247).

fields.name: guardian_mp
fields.description: `guardians_oath`: the MP that the guardian got back. Can be `0` (node/server.js:4248).

fields.name: dreturn
fields.description: Damage return: the HP that a melee attacker lost, from the `dreturn` of the target (node/server.js:4302).

fields.name: mobbing
fields.description: More than 3 monsters target the target: its combo counter (`target.combo`, node/server.js:3866).

fields.name: stacked
fields.description: The ids of the characters on the spot of the target. Each takes a part of the hit (node/server.js:3907-3910).

fields.name: unintentional
fields.description: This target is a splash or stack target (node/server.js:3977).

fields.name: splash
fields.description: This target took splash damage from `explosion` or `blast` (node/server.js:3980).

fields.name: aoe
fields.description: `cleave` or `shadowstrike` (node/server.js:3328, 3335).

fields.name: purify
fields.description: The `purify` skill (node/server.js:3401).

fields.name: sneak
fields.description: The attacker was invisible (node/server.js:4143).

fields.name: deepfreeze
fields.description: The `deepfreeze` skill froze the target (node/server.js:4174).

fields.name: trigger
fields.description: The `sugarrush` attribute of the attacker triggered (node/server.js:4122).

HitMiss.summary: A `hit` that did no damage: the attack missed.

fields.name: pid
fields.description: The projectile id.

fields.name: hid
fields.description: The id of the attacker.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The id of the target.

fields.name: damage
fields.description: Always `0`.

fields.name: miss
fields.description: The attack missed. Also when the target disconnected or died.

fields.name: source
fields.description: The skill.

HitEvade.summary: A `hit` that did no damage: the target evaded.

fields.name: pid
fields.description: The projectile id.

fields.name: hid
fields.description: The id of the attacker.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The id of the target.

fields.name: damage
fields.description: Always `0`.

fields.name: evade
fields.description: The target evaded. Only for physical damage.

fields.name: source
fields.description: The skill.

HitAvoid.summary: A `hit` that did no damage because the target moved away from the start point of the projectile.

fields.name: pid
fields.description: The projectile id.

fields.name: hid
fields.description: The id of the attacker.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The id of the target.

fields.name: damage
fields.description: Always `0`.

fields.name: avoid
fields.description: Always `true`.

fields.name: source
fields.description: The skill.

fields.name: x
fields.description: The start point: the position of the target when the `action` started.

fields.name: y
fields.description: The start point.

fields.name: map
fields.description: The map of the attacker.

fields.name: in
fields.description: The instance of the attacker.

HitReflect.summary: A `hit` that tells that the target reflected the projectile. It has no `source`.

fields.name: pid
fields.description: The projectile id of the first `action`.

fields.name: hid
fields.description: The id of the attacker.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The id of the target that reflected it.

fields.name: damage
fields.description: Always `0`.

fields.name: reflect
fields.description: The damage that goes back to the attacker. The same value is `reflect` in the new `action`.

HitBurn.summary: A `hit` from one tick of the `burned` condition. It has no `pid` and no `projectile`.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Always `"burn"`.

fields.name: hid
fields.description: On a monster: `f` of the condition, the name of the burner (a character name, or the `G.monsters` name of a monster, for example `"Goo"`). On a character: `fid` of the condition, the id of the burner.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The id of the burned entity.

fields.name: damage
fields.description: `ceil(intensity / 5)`.

fields.name: kill
fields.description: `true` when the HP is 0 or less after the tick, else `false`.

senders.what: `complete_attack`, when a projectile from an `action` arrives (`projectiles_loop`). Monster hits too: `mode.instant_monster_attacks` is 1 (node/server.js:292).
`complete_attack`: a miss, an evade or an avoid, before any damage.
`complete_attack`: a splash target with `avoidance` avoided the splash.
Burn ticks on monsters and on characters, in `update_instance`.
